coverage_note: Opening 01:54-03:19 is engine noise (Persian-like lines) before the lesson - skipped. From ~42:13 to the end many Medi turns are only '[speaking Arabic]' / '[speaking foreign language]': slips there are recoverable only from Amal's echo (45:48 qariban, 1:01:57 a3mal/a5alles) and several of his sentences (42:13-47:49, 57:14-57:56, 1:00:56-1:02:12) could not be checked. 09:26 'أنا ما أصل' unclear (answer to 'عندكم نعناع؟'), not scored. 13:05 engine wrote 'قصة' where he most likely said تسعة (the month, her prompt 'تلاتة وعشرين شو؟'; her 13:08/13:12 'تسا/أتسا'). 27:18 engine wrote 'بدول' = بضل (her recast أضل). 35:25 engine wrote 'أزا' = إجا. Echo candidates for this date checked: all real English, no Arabic sound-alikes. laazem_noun 21:21: he fixed himself (أنا لازم أحجز), no slip. 33:17 أشكي: her sheet has 'i complain | Ana bashki' so the form itself is on her list; her voiced change was لازم -> بدي (+ أشتكي). 26:54 'كم يوم؟ Or كم أيام؟' is a question, not scored. 1:02:40 زلمين is right (her chat zalamain).

rows.amal_said: How do you make قهوة two؟ ... No، it's feminine، so شو.

rows.medi_said: أنا دايمًا، اه، أحكي لك-- أحكيلها، إنه هي،
rows.chat: ana dayman ba7kilha enno heyye bteshrab ahwa kteer

rows.amal_said: بتشرب قهوة؟ كتير.

rows.amal_said: بتشرب قهوة؟ كتير.

rows.medi_said: اه، حكيت لك إنه أنا بقدر أدرس أحسن لما
rows.chat: ana 7akaitla 5atibti enno ana ba2dar a7ki a7san
rows.why: He is telling what he told his fiancee, but the ending says 'you'; her chat has 7akaitla 5atibti; not voiced.
rows.english: I told her that I can study better when

rows.amal_said: بس what's that has to do with your طم؟ شو يعني طم؟
rows.why: طم is mouth (sheet 'mouth | Tomm | تم'); he meant stomach ('stomach / belly | Bâ6en | بطن'); she asked what طم means and he fixed to بطني.
The stomach hurts = it-form (biywja3/beywajje3), he said the I-form; only her chat shows it.

rows.amal_said: ما؟ ... I didn't go. مش you did-- you don't go.

rows.why: He used a present you-feminine form for 'I didn't go'; she said it means 'you don't go' and he said ما رحت.

rows.medi_said: أنا بأكل نفس إشي أغلب من أيام.
rows.amal_said: نفس. What's the-- شو جمع إشي؟ ... أشياء، نفس الأشياء.
rows.chat: ana baakol nafs el-ashyaa2 a8lab el-ayyaam
rows.why: She asked for the plural of إشي and gave نفس الأشياء; his 09:05 repeat 'نفس أشياء' is the same moment.
rows.english: I eat the same things most days

rows.medi_said: أنا بأكل نفس إشي أغلب من أيام.
rows.amal_said: Most of most, most days. أغلب شو؟ الأيام.
rows.chat: ana baakol nafs el-ashyaa2 a8lab el-ayyaam
rows.why: a8lab + el- noun directly (idafa), no من and no bare noun; he said أغلب أيام again at 09:05, she prompted 'أغلب شو؟ الأيام' and he said الأيام.

rows.amal_said: ما إله طعم. النعناع الناشف. ... أهـم. ما إله طعم.
rows.chat: ma ilo ta3em = it doesn't have a taste
rows.right: ما إله طعم = it has no taste
rows.why: He did not understand her expression (heard ما as مع, إله as اللي) and asked; she taught it - a didn't-know.
English word in the Arabic phrase she had just taught; sheet 'لtaist / flavore | 6a3em | طعم'. Pre-ruled do-not-correct (AR-1933).

rows.medi_said: اه، تلاتة عشرين ألفين ستة وعشرين.
rows.amal_said: تلاتة وعشرين شو؟
rows.why: Date said without و in 23 and without the month; she recast تلاتة وعشرين and asked 'شو؟' for the month (engine wrote قصة for his answer, likely تسعة).

rows.medi_said: عشر دقائق إلا، إلا، إلا ثنتين-- اه، إلا ثلاث؟

rows.amal_said: عشرة.
rows.why: It was 2:50, ten to three; he said twenty, she supplied عشرة and he repeated it.

rows.amal_said: B. The first letter is B. ببدأ. So بدأ، yeah.

rows.amal_said: شو؟

rows.right: كمان نص ساعة = in half an hour

rows.medi_said: So، نسين؟ ... بسين؟ I don't know. انسينا؟
rows.amal_said: نسيت. نسينا.
rows.why: She asked what انسينا means; he could not parse it and she gave نسيت / نسينا (we forgot).

rows.medi_said: أنا لازم أحكي مع مديرك. أنا لازم أشكي.

rows.medi_said: وأنااا سألت، آآآ سألت، آآآ واحد موظفين.
rows.amal_said: استنى شوي. You asked him a question or you asked something of him؟
rows.why: سأل is ask a question; he meant asked someone to do something; she asked which and he said طلبت.

rows.amal_said: واحد. One. خلص. So you don't need say one.
rows.why: One + plural is wrong; the singular already means one; she said you don't need one and he said موظف.

rows.amal_said: من؟
rows.why: طلب takes من before the person; she prompted 'من؟' and he said من موظف.

rows.amal_said: الموظف ولا الموظف؟

rows.amal_said: When أزا؟ ... To come. So it's not to came. So it's to come.

rows.amal_said: هو أبدًا شو؟
rows.why: abadan needs ma on the verb; she prompted 'أبدًا شو؟' and he said ما يجي.

rows.amal_said: ما. It's came. He never came. ... Came past.

rows.amal_said: You didn't like.

rows.amal_said: الأمريكي. ... The American food. الأكل الأمريكي.
